meta.verdict_plain: Failed: 71% of homes dark at the worst hour (hour 298)
meta.cause_summary: h56: 2 GW of power plants frozen (Lubbock below -5 C for 7 h (low -11 C)), rising to 5 GW of power plants frozen (Lubbock below -5 C for 10 h (low -12 C)) by h59 -> h60: 1.2 GW of units failed to start in the cold, rising to 3.5 GW of units failed to start in the cold by h99 -> h61: Lubbock below -5 C for 12 h (low -12 C) -> h75: gas wells freezing (basin temp -5 C): production -11%, rising to production -25% by h93 -> h82: wind turbines iced or too cold: 29% of wind fleet stopped, rising to 51% of wind fleet stopped by h104 -> h85: demand surge to 64,290 MW -> h85: rotating outages begin (1,500 MW) -> h93: shedding cut power to gas facilities: -0.5 GW gas fuel -> h97: reserves below 2,300 MW (670 MW) -> h107: 2 GW of gas plants without fuel, rising to 16 GW of gas plants without fuel by h133 -> h110: under-frequency relays shed 5% at 59.3 Hz -> survived with rotating outages (peak 22,000 MW)
